title: The whole team at Machu Picchu

turns.text: This is our team. Make a group photo of all of them at Machu Picchu, the view in the second photo behind them, in hiking clothes, as if on a company trip. Same people, same number of people. 16:9.

tests: Nine faces at once: how many identities can one edit carry?

answer_sheet.Who: Everyone in the first photo, nine people.
answer_sheet.Where: Machu Picchu as in the second photo.

must_haves: There are nine people in the picture.
The people resemble those in the attached team photo (the same mix of men and women, hair and skin tones).
The ruins and the peak of Machu Picchu are behind them, as in the attached photo.
They wear hiking clothes; the picture is 16:9.
